VBO:0201422.summary: Poised and self-confident, the White Shepherd tends to be open and friendly with familiar people while watching strangers more reservedly. Its breed standard describes both herding and protective instincts, alongside an eagerness to respond when needed. Maintained by breeders who continued the white shepherd lines, this American breed gained separate United Kennel Club recognition in 1999.
VBO:0201422.shortDescription: Poised with familiar people and observant of strangers, the White Shepherd retains herding and protective instincts.
